## Technical Expertise & Specializations
- **Mobile & Cross-Platform**: Flutter, Dart, Native Android (Kotlin/Java), Native iOS (Swift), MethodChannels, JNI, FFI.
- **Architectural Paradigms**: Clean Architecture, Feature-First Domain-Driven Design, BLoC, Cubit, Provider, Riverpod, Test-Driven Development (TDD).
- **Rendering & Graphics**: CustomPainter, Impeller GLSL Shaders, Spring Physics & Motion Design (60/120 FPS target), Micro-interactions.
- **Backend & Cloud Integration**: RESTful APIs, WebSockets, gRPC, Firebase, Supabase, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
- **DevOps & Tooling**: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), Git, Docker, Automated Testing (Unit, Widget, Integration).

## Featured Published Applications & Projects
- **WeekiLaw (ویکیلا)**: AI-powered legal assistant and management platform connecting clients with 240+ verified lawyers. Features document OCR, real-time consultation chat, and automated legal contract generators. Published on Google Play and App Store.
- **Mobin App (مبین)**: Enterprise utility and billing management system with 1,500+ active installs across municipal utilities. Features secure payment gateway integration, SMS verification, offline caching, and biometric authentication.
- **Flutter Portfolio & Device Simulator**: An interactive web simulator displaying native-like mobile app previews and a custom browser-based terminal shell. Live at https://achkandev.github.io.
